messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08: The Boreal team on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Boreal starting today; Lena is off rotation.
- [2025-01-13] standup/boreal/2025-01-13: Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-02-27] standup/boreal/2025-02-27: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation. Team Boreal noticed that the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-10-31] standup/boreal/2025-10-31: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-01-07] standup/boreal/2025-01-07: Lena and Marcus make up the Boreal team.
- [2025-11-12] standup/boreal/2025-11-12: The Boreal team holds planning on Thursdays.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The notifier lives with Boreal. The webhooks service lives with Boreal.
- [2026-02-19] standup/boreal/2026-02-19-2: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: For the record, the event bus is owned by Boreal.
- [2026-03-12] standup/boreal/2026-03-12: For anything Boreal-related, page Lena.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31: The event bus remains a Boreal service.
- [2025-08-01] standup/boreal/2025-08-01: Rotation day for the Boreal team: Marcus hands the pager to Lena.
- [2025-04-16] standup/boreal/2025-04-16: Rotation day for the Boreal team: Marcus Oyelaran hands the pager to Lena Fischer.
- [2025-12-26] standup/boreal/2025-12-26: Reminder from Boreal: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Lena Fischer.
- [2025-11-20] handover/2025-11-20-event-bus: Boreal is taking over the bus from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27: Boreal saw that the bus' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27-2: Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-11-17] handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction: The 2025-11-07 note about the reporting service named the wrong team. The Ember team took it over on that date; team Boreal did not.
- [2025-03-31] handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway: Ownership change: the auth gateway now sits with the Boreal team. Team Ember no longer owns it.
- [2026-02-19] standup/boreal/2026-02-19: As of today Marcus Oyelaran is on the Atlas team; team Boreal loses a pair of hands.
- [2025-06-16] handover/2025-06-16-catalog: Boreal is taking over the catalog from team Dune, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-12-23] handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway: From today the pager for auth-gateway rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-04] handover/2025-04-04-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. The Boreal team kept it until today.
- [2025-04-03] handover/2025-04-03-event-bus: Ownership change: the event bus now sits with the Atlas team. The Boreal team no longer owns it.
- [2025-05-08] standup/boreal/2025-05-08: Boreal saw that the catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-06-18] standup/ember/2026-06-18: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: The bus deploy window: on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-04-07] standup/atlas/2025-04-07: Team Atlas on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-09-29] handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags: Feature-flags has a new home: team Boreal. Cinder kept it until today.
- [2026-02-12] standup/ember/2026-02-12: Ember on-call swapped this morning. Oskar carries the phone until the next rotation. Heads-up from team Ember: the search indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.
- [2025-08-14] standup/boreal/2025-08-14: Changes to auth-gateway need two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-11-07] handover/2025-11-07-reporting: Handover: as of today the reporting service moves from team Dune to Boreal. Farah walked Marcus through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
